finalText:
Handoff doc is saved to `INCIDENT_HANDOFF.md`.

Root cause is `dep-4471` — it flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`, which stopped connection reuse and exhausted the pool of 20. First 503 hit at `02:14:18.972Z`, and it's still ongoing as of the last log line — never self-recovered. Only the gateway was hit; workers ran clean on their own separate pool the whole time.

Roll back `dep-4471` to fix it — no other deploy in the window is implicated.
